question: how to do the skill moves on fifa 16 for xbox one
answer: To perform skill moves on FIFA 16 for Xbox One, you need to use combinations of buttons on your controller. For example, to do a Ball Juggle while your character is standing, hold LT and tap RB. Video guides showing what each skill move looks like are available at the top of the relevant page.
